checkedAlternates.risk: Figure-Eight Loop shares the Figure-Eight name.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Figure-Eight Loop forms a closed secure loop (group-4), whereas the simple Figure-Eight is a stopper knot (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Clove Hitch can be tied around a post quickly.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Hitches attach a rope to a spar, post, or ring (group-3), whereas bends join two rope ends together (group-2).
